title: King Charles Says U.K.’s Role in Slave Trade ‘Fills My Heart With Horror’
summary_full: The monarch called Britain’s trafficking of slaves from Africa a “shameful chapter of history” at a meeting of Commonwealth heads of government in Antigua.
